_why: engines/chatterbox-shared/requirements.txt is generated by pip-tools; its one long line is not prose. allow_flags are third-party flags the docs cite (curl's --form-string, llama-server's --cache-idle-slots/--cache-ram) that this repo's source never defines. src/ggufMetadata.ts:5 cites an upstream GGUF-format URL ending in gguf.md, which path-drift misreads as a repo-relative path.
